page_title: SEV 3-0 GRA | Sevilla v Granada CF 05/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Mateo Busquets Ferrer is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Loic Bade (Sevilla) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
90+2' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Joan Jordan (Sevilla) in, Boubakary Soumare out.

90' Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Orjan Nyland makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
90' Granada CF force their opponents to concede a corner.
89' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
87' Substitution. Theodor Corbeanu (Granada CF) on for Facundo Pellistri.

87' A pass travels right across the box to Alejo Veliz (Sevilla) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom left corner, but Augusto Batalla denies him with a decent save.
87' A clumsy foul by Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle.
86' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
84' Quique Sanchez Flores prepares a substitution. Lucas Ocampos is replaced by Hannibal Mejbri (Sevilla).
84' Substitution. Alejo Veliz (Sevilla) replaces Youssef En Nesyri.
83' An attempted cross from Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) is cleared.

80' 3 - 0 Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Augusto Batalla is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top left corner. The score is 3:0.
78' Jose Ramon Sandoval has decided to make a change. Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) replaces Lucas Boye.
77' The game has come to an end for Gerard Gumbau. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF).
77' The linesman makes the right call and Sevilla will have a corner.
76' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Augusto Batalla comes off the line to clear the ball away.
76' A lofted ball into the centre of the box is met with a forceful header by Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla), but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
74' Quique Sanchez Flores has decided to substitute Erik Lamela and he is replaced by Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) comes onto the pitch so that Kike Salas can be given a rest.
72' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
71' The attendance for today's match is 32658.

70' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
68' The ball possession at the moment is 61:39.
65' Lucien Agoume picks out Erik Lamela (Sevilla), who drives a shot just wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
65' Erik Lamela (Sevilla) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
62' Jose Ramon Sandoval decides to make a substitution. Sergio Ruiz will be replaced by Martin Hongla (Granada CF).
62' Matias Arezo goes off the pitch and Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) comes on.
62' The game is interrupted. Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
62' Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
61' A cross into the box from Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is cleared.
59' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
58' Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) is able to continue to play.
56' Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
55' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) commits a foul and Mateo Busquets Ferrer immediately signals a free kick.
54' Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
53' Yellow card. Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

51' 2 - 0 Goal! Lucas Ocampos manages to prod the ball to Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
51' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
50' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
49' Excellent touch by Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Corner kick. Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) is ready to send the ball into the box.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF). Mateo Busquets Ferrer saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
42' 58:42 – the latest ball possession ratio.
39' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sevilla.
38' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
38' The Granada CF players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to the ball going out of play.
37' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) scores a goal, but Mateo Busquets Ferrer makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether the goal can stand.
36' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
35' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
34' The game is interrupted now, Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Granada CF will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
33' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
33' A cross from Carlos Neva (Granada CF) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
30' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
30' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
29' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
29' Bruno Mendez (Granada CF) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for an infringement.
28' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
27' 1:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
24' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

23' Matias Arezo (Granada CF) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Orjan Nyland pulls off an easy save.
22' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows the whistle, Erik Lamela (Sevilla) is penalised for a foul.
21' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
19' Matias Arezo (Granada CF) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.

17' Erik Lamela (Sevilla) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Mateo Busquets Ferrer with no other option than to blow for a foul.
16' A corner kick by Sevilla is thwarted by the well prepared Augusto Batalla (Granada CF).
16' He should have scored! Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
14' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle. Lucas Boye (Granada CF) commits a foul after dangerous play.

12' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) makes it 1:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Jesus Navas and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Augusto Batalla was helpless.
10' The referee blows his whistle as Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) was too aggressive in his challenge.
8' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
6' A lofted cross from Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
2' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Granada CF will have the kick-off.
Mateo Busquets Ferrer got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
